title: רב אחא בר עזא

paragraphs: Rav Acha bar Azza said in Rav Abaye’s name (I think Assi should be read), before Rav Chisda. Rav Hamnuna sat before him. Before Rav Huna, Ellu Tereifot 49a; our version has Rabbi Acha bar Abba sitting before Rav Huna and saying in Rabbi Mallukh’s name in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak teaches it thus. Rav Acha bar Azza said [אראב״ע; contextual expansion], Temurah 21a. Rava bar Azza—perhaps an error. Kiddushin 81b: Rav Adda bar Azza in Rabbi Assi’s name—perhaps an error. Ellu Tereifot 50b has Rav Acha bar Ava in Rabbi Assi’s name twice. Undoubtedly all are one, with an error in one of them.
